start: Demo gym as the owner; menu > Messages & offers

user_sees: "Pick a message", box "Kind of message", "Who gets it"
List "Sent in the app" with five made-up messages (Zumba batch, Bring a friend, Gym closed, Sunday timings, New dumbbell rack), each with how many members have seen it
must_not: "Nothing sent yet"
"Loading…" that never ends
An offer-limit warning with no reason

steps.action: Pick a kind, type "Title" and "Message", tap "Send in the app"
user_sees: A question such as "Goes to … members in the app. Send now?" with "Yes, send" and "Not yet"
must_not: The message sent before the question

user_sees: "Sending…" then "Sent to … members in the app."
The new message on top of "Sent in the app" with 0 seen
Pill "Sent in the app" in place of the button
must_not: A real push to any phone
Two copies in the list
A member count that differs from the question

start: Demo gym as the owner; Messages & offers, the "When" box in "In the MettleUp app" (a timed message, another kind)

steps.action: Pick a group, set "When" to later and a "Day and time" tomorrow, tap "Send in the app" then "Yes, send"
user_sees: "Goes out … to … members in the app."
The message in the list with "Goes out …" and a "Cancel" button
Pill "To a group"
must_not: It shows as already sent
The count is every member, not the group

user_sees: Pill "Cancelled"; the card fades
must_not: Pill "Taken back" on a message that never went out

steps.action: Open Messages & offers, write a message, tap "Send in the app" then "Yes, send"
user_sees: A plain refusal that only the owner can send
Nothing new in "Sent in the app"
must_not: "Sent to … members in the app."
A raw "OWNER_ONLY" word

steps.action: Tap "Take back" on a sent message and confirm
user_sees: A plain refusal; the message is not marked "Taken back"
must_not: The message shown as taken back for the desk

start: Demo gym as the owner; Messages & offers

steps.action: Leave "Title" empty and look at the button
user_sees: "Send in the app" greyed out, with the reason in words
must_not: An untitled message sent

steps.action: Send an offer, then write a second offer the same day
user_sees: "Members get at most one offer or event a day in the app, and three a week." and the button greyed out
must_not: A second offer sent the same day

start: Demo gym as the owner; a message sent a moment ago

user_sees: Question "Take back “…”? It is removed from every member’s inbox."
must_not: Taken back with no question

user_sees: Pill "Taken back"; the card fades; no "Take back" button any more
must_not: The message gone from the list
A way to take it back twice

user_sees: The five seeded messages only; none taken back
must_not: The sent or taken-back message kept

start: Demo gym as the owner; Messages & offers, "Who gets it"

steps.action: Read the members who have the app and the seen counts
user_sees: Made-up members only; counts of the sample gym
must_not: A real member, a real phone number, a real send on WhatsApp or push

steps.action: Pick a kind that is "Sent on WhatsApp only" and tap its WhatsApp button
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with a made-up number, or the demo words; nothing is sent by itself
must_not: A message sent to a real person without the prospect pressing send in WhatsApp
